about: The fixed Jev questions: the user's four-part tie check (docs/tools.md: tie-stage check) and the three checks after every item and step (SKILL.md: the core, idea 2). Each is worded so that yes means right. p is Jev's probability of yes. A 'may only fail' question can never pass: a p at or above its fail line is unsure, and the script and the Claude checker decide. Thresholds are provisional (docs/tools.md: thresholds and calibration). The doer never words a Jev question.
modelNote: a pinned version, never the alias typesafe-ai/jev (tools: Jev client 7); 1.14.0 is provisional until calibration picks the version
priceSource: the AI Gateway's model list, read 2026-11-23: input $0.000000042 per token, output $0

tie-part1.question: Does this output show a pass?
tie-part1.source: tools: tie-stage check, part 1 (Jev is asked on the script's output and may only fail; fail line: every other question type)

tie-part2-clause.question: Does `{file}` carry out this clause of its rule: '{clause}'?
tie-part2-clause.source: tools: tie-stage check, part 2, per clause; thresholds: clause carried out

tie-part2-list.question: Does this clause list cover every requirement of the rule's text?
tie-part2-list.source: tools: tie-stage check, part 2, per rule; thresholds: clause list covers the rule's text

tie-part3-file.question: Does everything in `{file}` serve its rule '{bold}', with no part doing something its rule does not ask for?
tie-part3-file.source: tools: tie-stage check, part 3, per file; thresholds: the file serves only its rule

tie-part4-piece.question: Is this piece of code free of the job of the rule '{bold}'?
tie-part4-piece.source: tools: tie-stage check, part 4, per piece and candidate rule, in the user's words 'Is this file free of other rules jobs?'; reworded so that yes means right, so not yet calibrated: every other question type

correct.question: Was it done correctly, based on these instructions?
correct.source: SKILL.md: the core, idea 2, correct; thresholds: every other question type

same-code.question: Does the code pass all of the same checks it did before?
same-code.source: SKILL.md: the core, idea 2, same, for code; thresholds: every other question type

same-meaning.question: Does the CLAUDE.md have the exact same meaning as before?
same-meaning.source: SKILL.md: the core, idea 2, same, for a CLAUDE.md; thresholds: same meaning after a move

complete.question: Was this completed completely, and not only in part?
complete.source: SKILL.md: the core, idea 2, complete; thresholds: every other question type

whole-process.question: Have we implemented the whole process correctly?
whole-process.source: SKILL.md: the core, idea 3; thresholds: every other question type
